description: Jim Wendler’s 5/3/1: the training max from a one-rep max (or a recent set of weight × reps) and every set of a four-week cycle, warm-ups and the deload, rounded to loadable weights. Option one or two percentages, a 90% or lower training max, and the next cycle’s training max for a named lift. Percentages and rounding follow Wendler’s 2009 manual.

lift.description: Optional: squat, bench, deadlift or press, to add the next cycle’s training max (+5 kg or 10 lb lower body, +2.5 kg or 5 lb upper body).

oneRepMax.description: A tested or estimated one-rep max. Give this, or weight and reps.

option.description: The manual’s percentage option: one (65/75/85, 70/80/90, 75/85/95; recommended) or two (heavier first sets in weeks 1 and 2).

tmPercent.description: Training max as a percentage of the max, 80 to 95. The manual uses 90; 85 is the cautious choice.

unit.description: Weight unit for every load in and out: kg or lb.

weight.description: Weight of a recent set, used with reps to estimate the max (Epley).

name: five_three_one
title: 5/3/1 calculator
